umwayi

Every command, from the real command line. Tap a group to open it.

  • memorymemory commands
    • bundleprint the context bundle for an AI helper
  • queuequeue commands (queue.md)
    • listlist rows of the queue
    • addadd an open task or decision
    • answermark an open row as answered
    • closeclose a row
    • migrateconvert an old six column queue.md to the current layout (once)
  • decisiondecision commands (layer 13): reopen a closed decision as a new question
    • reopenreopen an answered or closed decision: one new logbook entry that links the old entry by its hash, and one new open decision in the queue
  • petitionan AI helper objects to a No rule (layer 13): one open queue item for the owner
  • autonomygraded autonomy (layer 13): the owner's record, the score per class and autonomy.yaml
    • statusper class: the counts, the score, the thresholds and the first gate that holds it (changes nothing)
    • validatecheck autonomy.yaml and the opt-in rules, every problem with a line number (changes nothing)
    • recordrecord one outcome of the owner for a class: one chained logbook entry
  • archivearchive commands
    • movemove a block of text out of a file into the archive
    • verifyrecompute every SHA-256 fingerprint and compare with archive/INDEX.md
  • checkcheck an action (JSON) against the rules: Yes (0), No (2), Ask me first (3)
  • rulesrules commands
    • duelist the rules that have lapsed or are due for review (changes nothing)
  • runrun one job from a jobs file (asks the rules first)
  • reportwrite a progress report draft from git history
  • publish-draftcopy a draft to outbox/ for the owner to post by hand
  • stewardAI helper Steward: read the queue and write a proposal draft
  • socialAI helper social: turn an article into post drafts
    • draftwrite one post draft per channel in umwayi.json
  • workflowworkflow commands (workflows/NAME.yaml)
    • validatecheck a workflow file, report every problem with a line number
    • runrun the steps of a workflow in order (asks the rules for every step)
  • killthe kill switch: stops every AI helper, job and workflow
    • onturn the kill switch on (creates .umwayi/KILL)
    • offturn the kill switch off (removes .umwayi/KILL)
    • statusshow the kill switch: off (exit 0), on or unknown (exit 3)
  • agentthe front door for AI agents (agents.yaml)
    • validatecheck agents.yaml, report every problem with a line number
    • listlist the agents in agents.yaml (starts nothing)
    • checkcan this agent be gated? runs every gate check, starts no agent
    • runstart an agent once with a prompt (Claude Code or Kiro)
    • chata chat with an agent on your terminal (transport cli)
    • loginsign in on your terminal (Claude Code ACP: claude.ai; Kiro: kiro-cli login), then the login check
  • schedulescheduled runs through systemd user timers (layer 11)
    • validatecheck schedule.yaml, every problem with a line number (writes nothing)
    • showprint the unit files (or --cron lines) install would write (writes nothing)
    • checkcompare the installed unit files with what umwayi would write (writes nothing)
    • installwrite the two unit files of one entry (asks the rules)
    • removeremove the two unit files umwayi wrote for one entry (asks the rules)
  • budgetthe budget governor (units.yaml, the ledger in the logbook)
    • validatecheck units.yaml, every problem with a line number (writes nothing)
    • statusused, reserved and left per limit, and the measured, declared and unknown shares (writes nothing)
    • calibratepropose per_run and per_day from 20 measured runs over 7 days (changes nothing)
    • settle-lostsettle every reservation that has no settle (after a SIGKILL or a crash), as unknown at the worst case
  • viewthe web interface (layer 12)
    • snapshotwrite one JSON file of counts for the page, and one logbook entry (no text, path or secret of any file)
  • servethe local backend for the web page (W6)
    • tokenthe token of the local backend: shown once, kept only as a SHA-256
      • createmake the first token and show it once (on a terminal only)
      • rotatemake a new token, show it once
      • revokeremove the token: every request is refused until a new one is created
      • statusthe id, the dates and the days left
  • goalgoal orchestration (W9)
    • docsbuild or check docs/status-log.md and docs/KNOWN-LIMITS.md from docs-parts/ (W9.R14)
      • buildwrite the two files from the frozen base and the part files, and write the number of each new limit into its part (nothing is written if any part is bad)
      • checkexit 0 if the two files equal the build, 2 if not (writes nothing)
    • guardload guidance.yaml and, given a task record (a JSON file), refuse a task that breaks an enforce rule (W19.1)
  • guidanceguidance.yaml: list the entries, verify the hub hashes (W19.1)
    • listone line per entry: kind, tier, source repo and whether it is verified (a hub entry is unverified unless --hub is given and its file matches)
    • verifycompare the stored hub hashes with the real hub files
  • concernsthe project concerns record (W19)
    • checkcheck that a concerns record has one well formed row for each of the 111 engineering concepts
  • routingthe model routing table and the task log (W19 part 3b)
    • checkcheck that a model routing table or a task log is well formed
  • stallsthe Kiro Crew lessons as checks (W19 part 5)
    • checkread a JSON list of builder events and report, one line per finding: a stall (30 minutes with no push or event), the same error twice in a row, an owner approval past its deadline (counts as No), a status with no last event time
  • logbooklogbook commands
    • verifycheck the format, the hash record and the hash chain of LOGBOOK.md (changes nothing)
    • anchorprint COUNT:HEX of the hash chain, to keep outside this machine (changes nothing)
    • sealrecord the hash of LOGBOOK.md as it is now (explicit, never automatic)
    • recovercut back the torn tail an interrupted write left (explicit, never automatic)

22 groups and 57 commands.

Made from the command line when the page was built. To refresh it, run python ui/tools/cli_map.py and then node build.mjs in ui.
